name: sync
description: Sync - club and membership management application

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @sync/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @sync/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @sync/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test scripts/supervisor.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @sync/api -w @sync/worker -w @sync/web
scripts.validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke
